editorial:
Ever wonder what actually happens to your information after you click a button online? You get to find out in this fun ride hosted by Dr. Hannah Fry. She takes a topic that sounds boring, like math and spreadsheets, and turns it into a wild adventure. The vibe is light and fast, making you feel like you are chatting with a smart friend who just wants to show you how the world really works. You will meet the hidden geniuses who built the digital world we live in today, and you will see how their inventions changed everything about how we live and think.

What really works here is how the movie avoids getting bogged down in technical jargon. The pacing is snappy, and the visuals help you picture things that are usually invisible. While some parts might feel a bit too quick if you want a deep dive, it is perfect for a casual night in. It is a great pick for anyone who likes learning new things without feeling like they are back in a classroom.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up by showing you that data is not just about numbers, but about people. It ends with a look at the future, explaining that while computers are powerful, they still need human intuition to make sense of the world. The final scenes leave you thinking about how your own digital footprint shapes your life. It concludes that the real magic happens when human creativity meets big data to solve huge problems.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves learning how technology works in a simple way.
